genxml.title: O2 MACE video output channel registers as the IRIX O2 video driver reaches them
genxml.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
genxml.doc: Register offsets, widths and the fields the reading could state for the output channel. Offsets are from the output channel base, which is a fixed displacement in the video window. Prose and the reasoning are in docs/mace-video.md.

struct.name: OUT_CONTROL
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Channel control word. The driver writes the whole word, changing only its low nine bits. The output recovery routines pulse bit 0. The reading read the routines that write it in a workspace and did not re-read them, so the grade is inferred.

struct.name: OUT_STATUS
struct.from: MACE 2.0 specification, pages 36 and 37 as the reading cites them
struct.doc: Status word. Reading it clears the pending interrupt causes. The output recovery routines read it after their last write and discard the value. The page numbers were not checked against the document.

struct.name: OUT_CONFIG
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Configuration word, written at start-up. Its field layout is not recorded here; the hardware configuration register at at 0x58 is a separate word.

struct.name: OUT_NEXT_DESCRIPTOR
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Physical address of the next descriptor block, held as a zero-extended 32-bit word. The recovery routines write it as well. Which bits carry the flag byte the driver ORs in is not stated.

struct.name: OUT_FIELD_OFFSET
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Field offset. The driver writes the low halfword of a transfer-record word here.

struct.name: OUT_FIELD_SIZE
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Field size. The reading takes the line count and the bytes per line from one stored value, which it gives as 243 lines of 2880 bytes in one set and 288 lines in the other.

struct.name: OUT_H_PAD_ODD
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Horizontal padding word for the odd field. The reading states it is a 64-bit value. Its layout is not recorded.

struct.name: OUT_V_PAD_ODD
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Vertical padding word for the odd field. The reading states it is a 64-bit value. Its layout is not recorded.

struct.name: OUT_H_PAD_EVEN
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Horizontal padding word for the even field. The reading states it is a 64-bit value. Its layout is not recorded.

struct.name: OUT_V_PAD_EVEN
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Vertical padding word for the even field. The reading states it is a 64-bit value. Its layout is not recorded.

struct.name: OUT_GENLOCK_DELAY
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Genlock delay word, written at start-up with a 64-bit store. Its layout is not recorded.

struct.name: OUT_HW_CONFIG
struct.from: MACE 2.0 specification layout, as the shipped IRIX O2 video driver object uses it, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Hardware configuration word for the output channel: port reset and select bits, audio and genlock sync settings, the general-purpose output bit and the framelock start-of-field counts. Bits 4, 7 and 8 and the audio-sync reset bit are not assigned by the reading.
